test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. This ensures that the product is suitable for human use.

B. If the product is safe, the animals remain unhurt.

C. It is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people.

D. As a result, such tests are conducted on small animals.
solution:
The correct answer is "**CDBA**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage.
 
• **Statement C **is the first sentence of the passage as it begins with the **general fact **that it is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people**. **Opening** **statements are usually general facts.
 
• **Statement D **is the next sentence as it mentions it is the **result **of the previous statement. Unknown chemical can't be tested on humans and hence, it is tested on animals.
 
• **Statement B **is the next sentence as the previous sentence mentioned **animals**. This statement mentions that a product is considered safe only if animals remain unhurt.
 
• **Statement A **is the last sentence as it has a link with the opening statement. There is a logical progression from the first sentence which said that testing of chemicals on humans is illegal to animal testing to the **safety of the product** in the aftermath of successful tests on animals

Hence, the correct sequence is **CDBA.**

**The complete passage is:* C****. It is illegal to test unknown chemicals on people. **D**. As a result, such tests are conducted on small animals.** B.** If the product is safe, the animals remain unhurt.** A.** This ensures that the product is suitable for human use.*
